texts.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你已经涉足了自己无法理解的力量。谨言慎行，学会安于当下，因为在你选择的道路上，未来只会带来痛苦。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take what solace you can from the present, for on the path you've chosen the future holds only pain."

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

texts.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你已经涉足了自己无法理解的力量。谨言慎行，学会安于当下，因为在你选择的道路上，未来只会带来痛苦。”

万幸的是，除了搬离了[root.GetHisHer]自己的工作场所以外，[root.GetName]对领导层没有造成其他任何的扰乱。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take what solace you can from the present, for on the path you've chosen the future holds only pain."

Thankfully, aside from vacating [root.GetHisHer] workspace, [root.GetName] did not cause any other disruptions to leadership.

texts.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“行吧，你已经展露了自己的真实面目。我本有更好的期待。愿你的引擎炸响熄灭，与你一起坠入虚空。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Well, you've shown your true colors. Somehow, I expected better. May your engines sputter and die. To the void with you."

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“卑鄙！庸俗！懦夫！一想到我们以为你们是文明人……但我觉得种背信弃义是意料之中的——卑劣的本能和狭隘的贪婪一直是你们民族性格的标志。”

万幸的是，除了搬离了[root.GetHisHer]自己的工作场所以外，[root.GetName]对领导层没有造成其他任何的扰乱。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Despicable! Vulgar! Craven! To think that we ever considered you civilized... But I suppose such treachery was only to be expected - base instinct and petty greed ever were a mark of your people's character."

Thankfully, aside from vacating [root.GetHisHer] workspace, [root.GetName] did not cause any other disruptions to leadership.

在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“那么，为什么不让我知道这个小小的市场秘密呢？告诉我，这是个什么居心？有何利可图？你们这些白痴难道不知道你毁了我们双方吗？”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"So why wasn't I let in on this little market secret? Enlighten me, what's the angle here? Where's the profit? Don't you idiots know you've ruined us both?"

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

summary.text:
# 攻击城邦：派驻领袖离去 / Attack on [FROM.GetName]

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：利维坦 Leviathans / 霸主 Overlord
- 来源 Sources：events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt:13320（enclave.8000）, :6717（enclave.390）, :13203（enclave.7200）; events/leviathans_events_1.txt:7951（leviathans.605）, :2501（leviathans.155）; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1371, :1375–1377
- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（C6）

## 如何开始 How it starts
我们与某城邦开战（on_entering_battle）时，若麾下有从该城邦聘来的领袖，5天后该领袖离去：
When we enter battle against an enclave that supplied one of our leaders, that leader leaves 5 days later:
- 虚境行者导师（enclave.7200）；打捞大师（enclave.390）；策展人档案员（leviathans.605）；商人城邦联络官（经商人城邦的“遭受攻击”窗口 leviathans.156/159/162）。

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
单一领袖窗口 enclave.8000：领袖留言后离开；若其任职议会，议程进度-20%。正文与画面按领袖类型、是否任职议会变化。每类只触发一次（各自标记）。
One leader window: the leader leaves a parting message; a councilor's departure costs 20% agenda progress. Text and art vary by leader type and council seat.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

本导读未单列分支与结局；分支随各事件在上文说明，互斥结果在阅读器中以“择一”框显示。/ This guide does not list branches separately; they are described with each event above, and exclusive outcomes are boxed in the reader.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.

## 审阅记录 Review notes
- 更正：草稿把同一窗口分成三个一页故事（390、7200、605）；现合并为一个故事，商人城邦路线以跨故事链接接入。
  Correction: three duplicate one-page stories merged; the trader route links in from the trader reaction windows.
- 覆盖完整。Coverage complete.
